title: Connect M8 canonical Agent loop to scoped Skill execution
goal: Ensure the production M8 chat/Agent loop discovers, selects, executes, and verifies only Skills declared by the active default Agent.
context: M8CompositionRoot already constructs SkillRuntime and SkillAgentOrchestrator, but its canonical M6Orchestrator was initialized without SkillExecutionBoundary. The separate Skill runtime therefore did not prove that ordinary M8 Agent goals could execute Skills.
forbidden_changes: Do not add a PARuntime dependency on PASkills.
Do not bypass M6 policy/approval or SkillRuntime output verification.
Do not allow workspace.create-file when workspace tools are disabled.
Do not change UI or unrelated provider/model behavior.
acceptance_criteria: M8 canonical M6Orchestrator receives the Composition-owned SkillExecutionBoundary.
Allowed Skill IDs derive from the default Agent manifest; workspace.create-file is excluded unless workspace tools are enabled.
A regression test executes text.normalize through M8CompositionRoot and asserts a verified successful Skill observation.
M3, Agent Task Contract, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA workflows pass.
verification: Confirm M3, Agent Task Contract, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA CI gates.
dependencies: PR #451 canonical M6 Skill execution boundary
recovery: If the boundary or scope checks regress, amend this single task commit or revert it; do not claim acceptance before required CI passes.
